subject: GCL
body: Which cloud model gives you virtual machines that you manage, while Google manages the physical hardware?
explanation: With IaaS you manage the OS and apps; Compute Engine is Google Cloud's IaaS.

subject: GCL
body: Paying only for the computing resources you actually use is called
explanation: Cloud shifts spending from CapEx to OpEx.

subject: GCL
body: Moving from buying servers to paying for cloud services shifts spending from
explanation: CapEx is upfront; OpEx is ongoing and flexible.

subject: GCL
body: In the shared responsibility model, who is responsible for the physical security of Google's data centres?
explanation: Customers remain responsible for their data, identities and access.

subject: GCL
body: A Google Cloud region is
options: an edge cache for content delivery
a geographic area with several zones
a group of projects in one billing account
explanation: Spreading resources across zones protects against a zone failure.

subject: GCL
body: Which service runs containers on managed Kubernetes clusters?
explanation: GKE manages the Kubernetes control plane for you.

subject: GCL
body: Which service runs stateless containers without managing servers, scaling to zero when idle?
explanation: Cloud Run is serverless for containers.

subject: GCL
body: Which Google Cloud service is the main IaaS offering for virtual machines?
explanation: Compute Engine gives full control over VMs.

subject: GCL
body: Which service is Google Cloud's serverless data warehouse for SQL analytics on large datasets?
explanation: BigQuery separates storage and compute and bills by data processed or slots.

subject: GCL
body: Which service stores unstructured objects such as images, backups and videos?
explanation: Cloud Storage offers Standard, Nearline, Coldline and Archive classes.

subject: GCL
body: Which Cloud Storage class is cheapest for data accessed less than once a year?
explanation: Nearline suits monthly access, Coldline quarterly, Archive yearly.

subject: GCL
body: Which managed database is globally distributed, relational and strongly consistent?
explanation: Spanner scales horizontally across regions while keeping SQL and ACID transactions.

subject: GCL
body: Which managed service runs MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server databases?
explanation: Cloud SQL is a managed relational database for regional workloads.

subject: GCL
body: Which service is designed for streaming and batch data pipelines using Apache Beam?
explanation: Dataproc runs managed Spark and Hadoop instead.

subject: GCL
body: Which service provides asynchronous messaging between applications?
explanation: Publishers send messages to topics; subscribers receive them.

subject: GCL
body: Which Google Cloud tool is used for business intelligence dashboards and data modelling?
explanation: Looker uses a semantic layer (LookML) for consistent metrics.

subject: GCL
body: Which Google Cloud platform is used to build, train and deploy machine learning models?
explanation: Vertex AI unifies ML tooling, including access to Gemini models.

subject: GCL
body: A business wants to add image labelling with no ML expertise. The best fit is
options: training a custom model from scratch
hiring a team to label images by hand
a pre-trained API such as Cloud Vision API
explanation: Pre-trained APIs need no model training.

subject: GCL
body: Running SQL to create and use ML models directly inside the data warehouse is
explanation: BigQuery ML lets analysts build models with SQL.

subject: GCL
body: Which service manages who can do what on which Google Cloud resources?
explanation: IAM binds roles to principals on resources.

subject: GCL
body: Granting users only the permissions they need is the principle of
explanation: Prefer predefined or custom roles over broad basic roles.

subject: GCL
body: Which service protects web applications from DDoS and common web attacks?
explanation: Cloud Armor works with external load balancers.

subject: GCL
body: Customer-managed encryption keys are created and controlled in
explanation: Google encrypts data at rest by default; CMEK gives customers control of keys.

subject: GCL
body: The security model that verifies every request instead of trusting the network location is
explanation: Access depends on identity and device context.

subject: GCL
body: The top-level node in the Google Cloud resource hierarchy is the
explanation: Organization → folders → projects → resources.

subject: GCL
body: Policies set on a folder are
options: ignored by the projects inside it
applied only to the folder itself
explanation: IAM and organization policies inherit down the hierarchy.

subject: GCL
body: Which tool shows logs and metrics for Google Cloud services?
explanation: Formerly known as the Operations suite (Stackdriver).

subject: GCL
body: Site reliability engineering (SRE) uses an error budget to
options: set the number of engineers per team
explanation: If the budget is used up, teams focus on reliability.

subject: GCL
body: Discounts for committing to use resources for one or three years are
explanation: Sustained use discounts apply automatically for running VMs most of the month.

subject: GCL
body: Short-lived, interruptible VMs at a big discount are called
explanation: Good for fault-tolerant batch jobs.

subject: GCL
body: Which feature alerts you when spending reaches a set amount?
explanation: Budgets don't stop spending by themselves; they notify.

subject: GCL
body: Moving an application to the cloud with few or no changes is
explanation: It's the fastest migration path but gains fewer cloud benefits.

subject: GCL
body: Which Google Cloud offering helps manage applications consistently across on-premises and multiple clouds?
explanation: It brings a consistent Kubernetes platform to hybrid and multicloud.

subject: GCL
body: Splitting an application into small, independently deployable services is a
explanation: Containers and Kubernetes are common for microservices.

subject: GCL
body: An application programming interface (API) lets
options: servers run without an operating system
data be stored without a database
explanation: Apigee is Google Cloud's API management platform.
